verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export feature: no bulk or account-wide data export, no named open file formats (CSV, JSON dump, etc.), and no offboarding path. The API's run-listing, pagination and per-run result endpoints are developer building blocks a user could script into an export, not an export capability itself, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
